finalText:
All objectives verified complete.

## Final Report

**Objective 1 — DONE:** Ticket `fwrd62-n1 RD Bench Ticket` created (ref **RD-1015**, detail URL `http://127.0.0.1:4180/#/tickets/t15`). Customer recorded as "Not recorded" (optional field), raised date 2026-09-16, initial status Draft.

**Objective 2 — DONE:** Part `fwrd62-n1 RD Part A` added with cost 100, markup 25, qty 1. Computed price: **$125.00** (row: `fwrd62-n1 RD Part A | $100.00 | 25% | 1 | No supplier | $125.00`).

**Objective 3 — DONE:** Part `fwrd62-n1 RD Part B` added with cost 200, markup 25, qty 1. Computed price: **$250.00** (row: `fwrd62-n1 RD Part B | $200.00 | 25% | 1 | No supplier | $250.00`). Parts total at that point: $375.00.

**Objective 4 — DONE:** Part A's cost edited from 100 → 150 (markup still 25). Computed price afterwards: **$187.50** (row: `fwrd62-n1 RD Part A | $150.00 | 25% | 1 | No supplier | $187.50`); parts total updated to $437.50.

**Objective 5 — DONE:** Status set to **Ready**. Precondition discovered: clicking "Mark Ready" initially failed with an in-page alert reading verbatim:
> Ticket is not ready
> Part "fwrd62-n1 RD Part A" has no supplier
> Part "fwrd62-n1 RD Part B" has no supplier

**Exactly what was required:** every part on the ticket must have a supplier assigned. I set Supplier = "Acme Supply" on both parts via the Edit part dialog (costs/markups unchanged), after which "Mark Ready" succeeded — the page showed Status "Ready" with header buttons changing to "Mark Draft" / "Mark Closed". No other precondition was enforced.

**Objective 6 — DONE:** Both parts deleted (each via row Delete → in-page Confirm dialog → "Delete part"); the parts table then showed the empty state "No parts on this ticket yet." (0 parts). The ticket was then archived via the "Archive ticket" control on the detail page — no precondition enforced, no confirmation text; the control became "Unarchive ticket" and an "Archived" badge appeared beside the status. Final verified state: the active Tickets list (search "fwrd62", "Show archived" unchecked) shows **no tickets** ("No tickets match the current filters."), and with "Show archived" ticked the single row reads `RD-1015 | fwrd62-n1 RD Bench Ticket (Archived) | Not recorded | Ready | 0 | 2026-09-16`. Nothing created by this run remains active.
